name: What is involved in the tub to shower conversion process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the tub to shower conversion process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The conversion process typically begins with the removal of the old bathtub and surrounding wall materials. Next, any necessary plumbing modifications are made for the new shower head and drain. Sub-flooring and wall studs are inspected and prepared, followed by the installation of waterproofing membranes. Then, the new shower base or pan is installed, along with wall surrounds, which can be tile, acrylic, or other materials. Finally, fixtures like the showerhead, controls, and glass enclosures are installed to complete the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing the old tub, plumbing modifications, waterproofing, installing the new shower base and walls, and finally, fixtures and enclosures.
